title: NLRP3 Inflammasome NACHT (NLRP3 + ADP)
mechanism: Allosteric NACHT-domain stabilization locks NLRP3 in an inactive ADP-bound state, blocking IL-1β/ASC speck-driven amyloid-tau microglial neuroinflammation.
clinical_precedent: VTX3232, NT-0796 & ZYIL1 (Phase 2 CNS NLRP3 inhibitors)
